description: Use when an agent needs liquidation pressure as it happens. Returns 5-second buckets per symbol of long and short USD liquidated across venues, the dominant side and pressure against the symbol's own baseline, from a gap-free cursor. Costs 0.001 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

next.description: the `next` value of the previous answer; send it back unchanged to continue with no gap and no repeat

since.description: first call only: start time in milliseconds since the epoch, up to 24 h back; omit to begin 2 minutes back

symbols.description: comma list of up to 20 symbols, e.g. BTC,ETH,SOL or BTCUSDT,ETHUSDT (default SOL,BTC,ETH,XRP,DOGE)

name: get_liq_feed

data.description: the get_liq_feed payload; a real captured example is free at https://x402.ochinimus.app/api/sample/get_liq_feed

tool.description: the tool that produced this payload

title: Liquidation pressure feed
